name: zclass_node_has_renderable_di_predicate
description: zClass_Node::HasRenderableDiPredicate accepts nodes with a non-null display-instance pointer whose mode is one and whose flags do not include bit 0x10.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this predicate; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass/object3d source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4527f0 validates reading node->userDataOrDiRef, requiring mode == 1, rejecting flags with bit 0x10 set, and returning 1 only when all checks pass.
The native smoke verifies accepted display-instance state, flag-bit rejection, and null display-instance rejection.
